name: SubForm
kind: Developer workbench for Claude Code agents
title: a code editor that runs several Claude Code agents at once
summary: SubForm is a code editor that runs several Claude Code agents at once, each in its own git worktree, with hunk-by-hunk review and FormSlot checks before an agent writes.
lede: SubForm is a developer workbench: a code editor that runs several Claude Code agents at once. Each agent works in its own git worktree, you review its changes hunk by hunk, and what FormSlot already knows is shown before an agent writes. It runs in a browser or as a desktop app.
runs_on: macOS, Windows and Linux; also in a browser
checks: Gives each Claude Code session its own git worktree, so several agents work on one repository without stepping on each other.
Lets you accept or reject an agent's changes hunk by hunk, send comments back to the session and commit under your own identity.
Pauses an agent about to rewrite code that already exists until you choose to use it, adapt it or write new.
Serves an MCP server with nine tools so an agent can read the workbench's sessions, review and terminals.

facts.dd: FastAPI on 127.0.0.1 behind a local guard; owner-only changes need the window token
TypeScript and Vite 8 with CodeMirror 6, wrapped by a Tauri 2 desktop shell
A detached pty-host keeps shells and Claude Code running through an engine restart
MCP server with nine read-mostly tools; only review_comment changes state

chapters.title: See what already exists before an agent writes
chapters.text: A status item, a slots panel with search and manifests, and provenance badges in review show what FormSlot already knows. An agent about to rewrite existing code pauses until you choose to use it, adapt it or write new.

chapters.title: Hunk by hunk, then commit as yourself
chapters.text: Stage, diff, snapshot and rewind, then commit with trailers stripped and every commit audited. Push and Sign and Push check each push.

chapters.title: How a repository's files link
chapters.text: See how a repository's files link to each other, filter by folder or type, and click a node to open the file.

features.title: Agents in worktrees
features.text: Claude Code sessions each get their own git worktree, so several agents work on one repository without stepping on each other.
bullets: Claude Code terminals and headless chat runs

features.title: Review before commit
features.text: Accept or reject an agent's changes hunk by hunk, send comments back to the session, and commit under your own identity.
bullets: Commits have trailers stripped and every commit is audited
Push and Sign and Push check each push

features.title: FormSlot gates
features.text: An agent about to rewrite code that already exists pauses until you choose to use it, adapt it or write new.
bullets: Use, Adapt or Write new anyway

features.title: FormSlot in the editor
features.text: A status item, a slots panel with search and manifests, and provenance badges in review show what already exists.
bullets: Search slots, code and decisions from the side panel
Manifests and provenance badges in review

features.title: File graph
features.text: See how a repository's files link to each other.
bullets: Click a node to open the file

features.title: Editor
features.text: CodeMirror 6 with language servers and debugging.

features.title: Formats
features.text: Opens code, Markdown, images, video, audio and PDF.

features.title: Built for agents
features.text: The engine is an MCP server with nine read-mostly tools. Only review_comment changes state, and no tool writes files, commits or answers a gate.
bullets: ./subform mcp serves MCP on stdio for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
POST /mcp behind a local guard and a bearer token
A routing skill pack for agents

topics.title: Engine and ports
topics.text: ./subform starts the engine on 127.0.0.1:5655 and the web UI at http://localhost:5650; SUBFORM_PORT moves the engine port.

topics.title: Desktop window
topics.text: frontend/node_modules/.bin/tauri dev opens the desktop window instead of the browser.

topics.title: MCP endpoint
topics.text: The HTTP endpoint is POST /mcp, behind a local guard and a bearer token. See docs/MCP.md and AGENTS.md.

topics.title: First install
topics.text: New users can double-click Install subform.command or Install subform.bat. The guide is docs/GUIDE.md.

topics.title: Releases
topics.text: All SubForm builds are compiled and released from formcompiler; the repository holds the source.

items: Agent sessions read user settings only, so hooks in a checkout's .claude/settings.json no longer run
Boot loads half the script; xterm, language packs, Studio, the graph, review and the library panels load on first use
A failed terminal load shows a message and retries on the next open
One presets service for graphs, recipes, plugin and skill presets
Graph runs with edit or plan agents get their own worktree, gate token, settings and review target
Terminal routes and socket need the window token
Studio graph canvas and engine, graph runs with the simulator and Claude, recipes, triggers and approvals
Carries data, secrets, settings and window state over from the earlier name once
